title: Jennifer Marley opens the dancefloor with gritty banger "It's Callin' Me"
htmlContent: "It's Callin' Me," the new song by Jennifer Marley, is a dance track perfect for the nonstop beat of nighttime dance floors. Released under Haustronaut Recordings, this single features a strong bassline that grinds, grips, and pushes the body, making you want to dance from the first beat to the last. https://open.spotify.com/track/6AO3CplSXPfNkdwfETATZx This is the simplest type of house and tech house, and the bass moves the beat forward with a strong, almost predatory force. The male voice woven into the arrangement functions as a tonal signal that resonates with the primal appeal of the beat.  The song has a rough, edgy sound that sets it apart from polished mainstream club releases. Jennifer Marley lets the bass do the talking, making the whole song sound different. The music tells you to dance, and it pulls you in with its beat. "It's Callin' Me" has a unique sound that is raw, powerful, and full of life, which makes it great for the club. Jennifer Marley is making memories that will last long after the lights go out.
